name: cache-cargo-home
description: Granular, R2-backed cache for ~/.cargo/git/db and ~/.cargo/registry/cache, driven by Cargo.lock

scripts.build: rm -rf bundle && esbuild src/restore.ts src/save.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outdir=bundle --minify --legal-comments=none && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('bundle/package.json','{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}\n')"
